verses.text: Paul, apostle of Christ Jesus by God will, and Timothy wey be our brother,
to di holy people and di faithful brothers for Christ wey dey Colossae: Grace and peace from God our Papa dey with una.
We dey always thank God, di Papa of our Lord Jesus Christ, as we dey pray for una all di time,
because we don hear about una faith for Christ Jesus and di love wey una get for all di holy people,
because of di hope wey dem don keep for una for heaven, wey una don hear about before inside di word of di truth of di Good News,
wey don reach una. Just as e dey for all di world dey bear fruit and dey grow, na so e dey do for una too, from di day wey una hear and know God grace for truth.
Na so una learn am from Epaphras, our dear fellow servant, wey be faithful servant of Christ for our side.
Na im also tell us about una love for di Spirit.
Na why from di day wey we hear dis thing, we no stop to pray and ask God for una, so that una go full with di knowledge of im will, with all wisdom and understanding wey come from di Spirit,
so that una go live in way wey fit Lord, wey go please am for everything, as una dey bear fruit for every good work and dey grow for di knowledge of God;
make im strong una with all power, according to di might of im glory, so that una go fit endure and wait with patience and joy;
and make una dey thank Papa God, wey make us fit to share for di inheritance of im holy people for di light;
na im free us from di power of darkness and carry us enter di Kingdom of im Pikin wey e love.
Na for im we don get freedom, wey be di forgiveness of our sins.
Na im be di image of God wey nobody fit see, di firstborn of everything wey God create.

Because through am God create everything, for heaven and for earth, di things wey people fit see and di things wey dem no fit see, whether thrones or dominions or rulers or authorities. Everything dem create through am and for am.
E dey before everything, and na for im everything dey hold together.
Na im be di head of di body, wey be di church. Na im be di beginning, di firstborn from among di dead, so that for everything e go get di first place.
Because e please God make all im fullness dey inside am,
and through am make everything join God again, whether na things for earth or things for heaven, as e make peace through di blood of im cross.
Una wey before dey far from God, and una mind dey against am because of una evil work,
na now e don make una friend again through im death for im body of flesh, so that e go bring una stand before am holy, without fault and without blame,

if una continue for di faith, dey strong and stand well, and no move comot from di hope of di Good News wey una hear, wey dem don preach to everything wey God create under heaven. Na dis Good News make me, Paul, become servant.
Now I dey rejoice for my suffering wey I dey suffer for una sake, and for my own body I dey complete wetin remain for Christ affliction, for im body sake, wey be di church.
Na di church I become servant, according to di work wey God give me to do for una, to make di word of God complete,
di mystery wey dem hide from di ages and from generation dem. But now e don show to im holy people.
God want make dem know how rich di glory of dis mystery be among di Gentiles, and na Christ inside una, di hope of glory.
Na am we dey preach, as we dey warn everybody and teach everybody with all wisdom, so that we go bring everybody stand before God perfect for Christ.
For dis thing I dey work hard too, as I dey struggle with im power wey dey work inside me with strength.
I want make una know how big struggle I dey struggle for una, and for dem wey dey Laodicea, and for all dem wey never see my face with eye,
so that dem heart go get comfort, as dem join together for love, and dem go get all di riches of full understanding, so that dem go know di mystery of God, wey be Christ,
na inside am all di treasure of wisdom and knowledge dey hide.
I talk dis one so that nobody go deceive una with sweet word.
Even though I no dey with una for body, I dey with una for spirit, and I dey rejoice as I see how una dey stand in order and how una faith for Christ dey strong.
So as una don receive Christ Jesus wey be Lord, make una live inside am,
as una root and build up inside am, and make una faith strong, just as dem teach una, and make una full of thanks.
Make una take care, so that nobody no go carry una go like prisoner with im philosophy and empty deceit, wey follow di tradition of men and di basic things of di world, and no follow Christ.
Because na inside am all di fullness of God dey stay for body,
and na inside am una don full, and na im be di head of every ruler and authority.
Na inside am dem circumcise una too, no be with hand, but as dem comot di body of sins of di flesh, na di circumcision of Christ.
Dem bury una with am for baptism, and for di baptism too God raise una with am through faith for di work of God, wey raise am from di dead.
Una dey dead because of una trespass and because una flesh no circumcise. But God make una alive together with am, as e don forgive us all our trespass,
as e wipe out di written law wey dey against us. E don comot am from di way, as e nail am to di cross.
E strip di rulers and di authorities, e show dem openly for shame, as e win dem for di cross.
So make nobody judge una because of wetin una chop or drink, or because of feast day or new moon or Sabbath day,
wey be shadow of di things wey dey come, but di body na Christ own.
Make nobody carry una prize comot because e like to show humility and worship angel dem, as e dey follow wetin e don see, and im flesh mind dey puff am up for nothing,
and e no hold di Head tight. Na from di Head all di body dey get wetin e need and dey join together through di joints and di muscle dem, and e dey grow with di growth wey come from God.
If una die with Christ and free from di basic things of di world, why una dey obey rules like say una still dey live for di world?
“No handle am, no taste am, no touch am”
Dem na men commandment and teaching, and all of dem go spoil as people dey use dem.
Dese things look like wisdom because of worship wey people choose by demself, humility and hard treatment of di body, but dem no get any value to stop di flesh from dey follow im desire.
So if God don raise una together with Christ, make una look for di things wey dey up, wia Christ dey sit for di right hand of God.
Make una put una mind for di things wey dey up, no be di things wey dey for earth.
Because una don die, and una life dey hide with Christ inside God.
When Christ, wey be our life, show, den una go show with am for glory too.
So make una kill di things for una body wey dey for earth: sexual immorality, dirty life, bad passion, evil desire, and greed, wey be idol worship.
Because of dese things God anger dey come on di pikin dem of disobedience.
Una too dey live inside dese things before, when una dey live for dem.
But now make una put all dese ones away: anger, wrath, malice, slander, and shameful talk from una mouth.
No lie to each other, because una don comot di old man with im doings,
and una don wear di new man, wey dey get new life for knowledge, according to di image of di one wey create am.
For dis new life no dey Greek or Jew, circumcision or uncircumcision, foreigner, Scythian, slave or free man; but Christ na everything, and e dey inside everybody.
So as God chosen people, holy and dear to am, make una wear heart of compassion, kindness, lowliness, humility and patience.
Make una bear with each other and forgive each other, if anybody get complaint against another person. Just as Christ forgive una, na so una too must do.
Above all dese things, make una live for love, wey be di bond of perfection.
Make di peace of God rule inside una heart, because na for dis peace dem call una for one body; and make una dey thank God.

Make di word of Christ dey inside una plenty; make una teach and warn each other with all wisdom, with psalms, hymns and songs wey come from di Spirit, as una dey sing with grace for una heart to Lord.
Anything wey una dey do, for word or for work, make una do everything for di name of Lord Jesus, as una dey thank Papa God through am.
Wives, make una submit to una husband dem, as e suppose be for Lord.
Husbands, love una wives, and no dey bitter against dem.
Pikin dem, obey una papa and mama for everything, because dis one dey please Lord.
Papa dem, no provoke una pikin dem, so that dem no go lose heart.
Servants, obey for everything dem wey be una oga for dis world, no be only when dem dey look, like people wey wan please men, but with honest heart, as una dey fear Lord.
Anything wey una do, make una work am with all una heart, like say na for Lord, no be for men,
because una know say from Lord una go receive di inheritance as reward. Na Lord Christ una dey serve.
Because anybody wey do wrong go receive back for di wrong wey e do, and God no dey take sides.
Oga dem, give una servant dem wetin dey right and fair, because una know say una too get Lord for heaven.
Make una continue to pray without give up, dey watch and dey thank God.
Pray for us too, so that God go open door for di word, make we talk di mystery of Christ, wey make dem put me for chain,
so that I go make am clear, as I suppose talk am.
Make una behave with wisdom to dem wey dey outside, and use every time well.
Make una talk always dey with grace, dey season with salt, so that una go know how una suppose answer each person.
Tychicus, my dear brother, faithful servant and fellow servant for Lord, go tell una everything about how I dey.
I send am come to una for dis same reason, so that una go know how we dey, and so that e go comfort una heart,
with Onesimus, di faithful and dear brother, wey be one of una. Dem go tell una everything wey dey happen here.
Aristarchus, my fellow prisoner, dey greet una, and Mark, Barnabas cousin. About Mark una don receive instruction: if e come meet una, make una welcome am.
and Jesus wey dem dey call Justus. Na only dese ones among di circumcision dey work with me for God Kingdom, and dem don be comfort to me.
Epaphras, wey be one of una, servant of Christ, dey greet una. E dey always struggle for una for im prayer dem, so that una go stand perfect and sure for all God will.
I dey testify about am say e get plenty zeal for una, and for dem wey dey Laodicea, and for dem wey dey Hierapolis.
Luke, di dear doctor, and Demas dey greet una.
Greet di brothers wey dey Laodicea, and Nymphas, and di church wey dey im house.
When una don read dis letter among una, make una arrange am make dem read am for di church of di Laodiceans too; and make una read di letter wey dey come from Laodicea too.
Talk to Archippus say, “Take care of di work wey you receive for Lord, so that you go finish am.”
Na me, Paul, write dis greeting with my own hand. Remember my chain dem. Grace dey with una. Amen.
